messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":9,"verses":[{"chapter":9,"verse":16,"text":"16 And the tree of life planted in the middle of paradise will cause all the fruitless trees to bear fruit, and they will grow and sprout."},{"chapter":9,"verse":17,"text":"17 And the trees that had sprouted and became arrogant and said: ‘We have supplied our power to the air,’ he will cause them to wither, with the grandeur of their branches, and he will cause them to be judged, that firmly rooted tree!"},{"chapter":9,"verse":18,"text":"18 And what is crimson will become white as wool. The snow will be blackened. The sweet waters will become salty, and the salty sweet, in the intense light of the joy of God."},{"chapter":9,"verse":19,"text":"19 And he will bless the islands so that they become fruitful by the word of the mouth of his Messiah."},{"chapter":9,"verse":20,"text":"20 “For he will come, and he will go out and choose for himself twelve apostles to proclaim the news among the nations, he whom I have seen adorned by his father and coming into the world on the Mount of Olives, and he will fill the hungry souls.”"}],"book_code":"4BAR"}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 16,17,18,19,20 in this chapter.
